title: Sumatra – blad LIII

series.title: Sumatra
series.notes: Topographic map series of south Sumatra showing residency and administrative boundaries, transportation, ground and water features, vegetation, cultivation, religious sites, settlements and buildings. Relief shown by contours, shading and spot heights. | Includes index to adjoining sheets, boundary diagram, abbreviations and compilation notes. | Map in Dutch. | Each sheet is named and numbered individually.

creator: Netherlands. Topografische Dienst, cartographer. issuing body.
